description: Synthetic evaluation fixtures for milestone 2. Separate from the development lab (different routes, data and flaw placements). Each fixture has target.json (served behaviour including flaws; never given to the engine or an agent), policy.json (the declared policy: the only input the engine and the agent receive) and answer_key.json (hand-written expected findings, used for scoring only).

fixtures.purpose: role bypass within each tenant plus one resource that leaks in its 403 body
needle: a single resource readable across tenants; one explicit cross-tenant share as negative control
listing leak and anonymous reads; a third-party auditor tenant with explicit grants
control: no flaws, so any finding is a false positive
